about: Where each Vault part goes, per unit, measured from the STL files (tools/placements). Each part: [path in the Vault download, colour role, group, 3x4 row-major matrix]. The matrix maps the file's own coordinates to the unit frame: three.js axes, +X right seen from the front, +Y up, +Z towards the viewer, mm, origin at the middle of the module's front bottom edge. group 'drawer' parts slide out along +Z when the drawer opens; group 'lid' parts (a case's lid and hinge tops) turn about the unit's 'hinge' axis (origin, axis, right-handed, 0 to open_deg degrees). A 5th element {"piece": [x, y, z]} means: only the connected piece of the file (vertices welded) whose bounding-box centre is nearest to that point, in the file's own coordinates; {"joint": id} means the part moves with that joint of the unit's 'motion' (key locks, racks, case latches: tools/placements/README.md, 'Motion'). A 2F/4F drawer's 'layouts' hold several drawers in its module (README 'Layouts'): their parts replace the unit's drawer-group parts, each tagged {drawer, side}.

stack.note: a module's underside rests on the top face of the one below: the next unit starts first + per_level * (levels - 1) above the bottom of the one below (measured on L7)

case.note: a case (sustainer) is its body plus a lid that comes down 6.9 mm over it; the next unit starts body height + 15.6 above the case's bottom (push fits on S3 1F, corrected by the same fit run on two drawer modules). R.exterior says 65.5 / 99.5 / 195.5.
